statement: THEOREM. Let Ω be the trapezoid with vertices A=(0,0), B=(1,0), C=(17/20,9/10), D=(1/4,9/10) — convex, side slopes 6 and 18/5, no axis of symmetry, not a lip domain; to our knowledge outside every class for which the hot spots conjecture was previously proven. The second Neumann eigenvalue μ1 is SIMPLE, with μ1 ∈ [12.020976137861565, 12.022398348138436], and the second Neumann eigenfunction attains its maximum and its minimum on ∂Ω ONLY.
